description: Java source code for the REST API resource handling teller operations in the Fineract project, including endpoints for managing tellers, cashiers, transactions, and journals.

classes.name: TellerApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing tellers, cashiers, transactions, and journals in the Fineract system.

methods.name: getTellerData
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tellers, optionally filtered by officeId.

methods.name: findTeller
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific teller by ID.

methods.name: createTeller
methods.description: Creates a new teller with provided data.

methods.name: updateTeller
methods.description: Updates an existing teller identified by ID.

methods.name: getCashierData
methods.description: Lists cashiers for a specific teller within a date range.

methods.name: findCashierData
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cashier.

methods.name: getCashierTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for creating a new cashier.

methods.name: createCashier
methods.description: Creates a new cashier for a teller.

methods.name: getTransactionsForCashier
methods.description: Retrieves transactions for a cashier with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getTransactionsWithSummaryForCashier
methods.description: Retrieves transactions with summary info for a cashier.

methods.name: getCashierTxnTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction template for a cashier.

methods.name: getTransactionData
methods.description: Retrieves teller transactions within a date range.

methods.name: findTransactionData
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific teller transaction.

methods.name: getJournalData
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries for a teller within a date range.
